capabilities: Track per-note session time with edit/read split
Detect idle time with configurable thresholds
Show dashboard with five ranges and four tabs
Export sessions as CSV, JSON, or Markdown
Write focus totals into note frontmatter
extras: Data is stored inside the plugin folder (.obsidian/plugins/focus-time/store/), so removing the plugin deletes the history; the README says to export or copy it before reinstalling. Version 1.x cannot read the new event log.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see how much time is spent in each note or when work actually happens.
summary: Time-tracking plugin that records how long each note is open and shows the data in a dashboard with trends, notes, and folder categories.
